question.text: Regulation 91(D)(8) of LODR requires that a Social Enterprise shall:

answer.text: Disclose on its website all events or information disclosed to the SSE under Regulation 91(D).
Disclose on its website only events occurring in the last 30 days.
Disclose on its website only events exceeding INR 1 crore in financial impact.
Disclose on its website only at the end of each financial year.

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 91(D)(8) requires the SE to disclose on ITS WEBSITE all events or information that have been disclosed to SSE under Regulation 91(D). There is no monetary threshold, no 30-day cap and no year-end batching. The Trap: Options B-D are invented thresholds that mimic main-board Reg 30 / 46 patterns. 91(D)(8) is a straightforward 'mirror on the website whatever you filed with SSE' rule. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C tests Reg 46 website disclosures for main-board issuers - similar philosophy but different citation. XXIII tests 91(D)(8) literally. Assessor's Pro-Tip: During the SIA's website walk-through for an AIR engagement, test every 91(D) filing against the NPO's website in parallel tabs. A filing made but not mirrored on the website is itself a non-compliance, even though the SSE copy is fine.
